name: Chillspine

abilities.name: Ice Bolt
abilities.description: Basic ranged attack dealing moderate frost damage.

abilities.name: Ice Pillar/Ice Pillar Chill
abilities.description: Chillspine summons an Ice Pillar on a target, dealing minor frost damage on summon and slowing targets in a small area around it as long as it stands. Staying more than a second in the area will also immobilize you.

abilities.name: Frost Wave
abilities.description: Chillspine channels a spell launching many icy whirlwinds in an arc in front of it, dealing high frost damage and snaring targets hit. This can be interrupted to stagger Chillspine.

dialogue.speaker: Chillspine
dialogue.line: Feel the icy touch of death!
dialogue.trigger: When you begin combat with it

summary: Chillspine is a wraith boss who specializes in icy attacks in the Spire of the Crimson Coin near the water mill.
